name: mocoder
description: A tutor that guides you to build your project by hand, task after task.

commands.title: Copy the prompt to create a backlog

enumDescriptions: Theory always visible, file skeletons, every hint
Theory on request, skeletons, the solution asks for confirmation
Only the goal and the checks: no skeletons, no hints
mocoder.guidance.description: How much the tutor helps you.

enumDescriptions: Any OpenAI-compatible API: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio, Ollama
mocoder.ai.provider.description: AI provider. Easier: the command "mocoder: Configure AI".

mocoder.ai.baseUrl.description: API address. Empty for Anthropic; e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

mocoder.ai.model.description: Model for the Planner and the reviews.

mocoder.ai.mentorModel.description: Model for the tutor questions. Empty = the same as mocoder.ai.model; a cheap or local model saves money.

mocoder.ai.monthlyTokenBudget.description: Maximum tokens per month (input + output). 0 = no limit.

enumDescriptions: Any OpenAI-compatible API: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio, Ollama
mocoder.ai.fallback.provider.description: Provider of the backup API key. Easier: the command "mocoder: Add a backup API key".

mocoder.ai.fallback.baseUrl.description: API address of the backup key. Empty for Anthropic.

mocoder.ai.fallback.model.description: Model of the backup key. Empty = no backup: mocoder keeps using the primary provider.

scripts.package: npm run build -- --minify && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository --out mocoder.vsix

untrustedWorkspaces.description: mocoder runs the task check commands: a trusted folder is required.
